subject: t-c-imp
title: T.C.IMP.------ACT.TR.
description: Diagram in (Level One) World Music section (WM-10), embedded in Braxton's argument that world creativity functions as 'a ritualization of the total understanding of its given culture group' rather than as standalone aesthetic product. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is crossed with ACT-TR (actual transformation), and the dashed edge from T-C-IMP to RT-DY (reality dynamics) amplifies some aspect of the main concept it is connected to. T-C-IMP branches two further ways: into PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism); and into PHY-U-P (physical universe particular), which bears on POL-CON (political consciousness) and on AFL (affinity alignment), with AFL extending through EXT-DYM (extended dynamics), a dashed link from EXT-DYM to INFO-DE-B (information degree basis), and INFO-DE-B leading to (r)INTR (interpretation). The argument: a culture's creative time-continuum implications only manifest as actual transformation when physical-universe particulars extend into affinity alignment and extended dynamics, and through information degree basis into interpretive practice — the WM section's case for world creativity as essence-functional rather than spectacle-viewable.
